newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee breaches 35.80 per dlr, at 4-mth high.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee breaches 35.80 per dlr, at 4-mth high.

text.p: The Indian rupee breached the 35.80 per dollar barrier on Thursday as the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) abstained from dollar purchases, dealers said.
"The dollar dipped to 35.79 today," said a dealer.
Spot rupee opened Thursday 35.80/81 against dollar.
Some dealers attributed the rise to poor import demand for dollars and RBI governor's statement earlier this week that the central bank was allowing the market to determine the rate.
After opening higher, the rupee was stead against the forward dollar, dealers said.
